Inferred
  - Connections that stopped answering without a close or reset: 3. This is the usual sign of a NAT or other middlebox silently dropping connection state.
  - Connections closed by the far side without a reason: 1. The node always states a reason before it closes a connection, so this points to a middlebox sending the close, or the node process exiting abnormally.
  - Connections ended by a reset or another error: 2.
  - Connections the node closed and said why: 25 (idle_timeout=25). These are not evidence of network drops.
Not proven
  - A silently dropped connection is only noticed when a heartbeat reply times out, so its lifetime is an upper bound, long by up to one heartbeat interval (30 s); closed or reset connections are noticed at once.
